answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 18758 Country: Pakistan Title: AOA> my question is that i and my husband read intercourse DUA befor we sleep at night and and then in midnight we do intercourse without reading that DUA.Is this tight way. i vl be thankful to you. Jazakallah Question: AOA> my question is that i and my husband read intercourse DUA befor we sleep at night and and then in midnight we do intercourse without reading that DUA.Is this tight way. i vl be thankful to you. Jazakallah Answer ID: 18758 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 77/77=B=1431) It is not sufficient to recite dua of intercourse before going to sleep; you should recite it when you make intention of having intercourse. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
